mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and profit margins, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a supply-constrained economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 0.5% and UNRATE falls below 0.3pp, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, with the effect amplified when unemployment rises rapidly.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 106.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 106.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
